newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA STOCKS END HIGHER DRIVEN BY FOREIGN FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA STOCKS END HIGHER DRIVEN BY FOREIGN FUNDS.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up at the end of the week as foreign funds bought blue chips.
Bogota's IBB index gained 1.49 percent to close at 1,259.15 on turnover of 3.1 billion pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED index climbed 0.54 percent to 18,933.02 on turnover of 3.9 billion pesos.
One of the day's biggest gainers was Banco Ganadero, up 3.8 percent to 435 on the Bogota exchange. Banco de Colombia rose 2.9 percent to 386 in Bogota.
